execution_scope: All five reports were read only. No supplied program, cluster, benchmark, patch or reproducer executed.

cases.title: Leader TiKV OOM when raft log persistence falls behind with apply-before-persist enabled
cases.reason: The report describes applied-but-unpersisted Raft log growing without store-wide byte admission until the leader is OOM-killed. Held as a resource-exhaustion and availability lead. No TiKV cluster, write benchmark or workaround was executed; safety impact is unassessed.
cases.reason_zh: 报告描述已应用但未持久化的 Raft 日志缺少 store 级字节准入，持续增长直至 leader 被 OOM 终止；按资源耗尽与可用性线索暂缓。未执行 TiKV 集群、写入基准或临时方案，安全影响未评估。

cases.title: bug: in-memory engine eviction controllers stall forever on dropped completion callbacks
cases.reason: The report describes dropped eviction callbacks leaving controller waits and memory-checking latches permanently pending. Held as an availability lead. No supplied PoC, TiKV engine, controller or patch test was executed; safety impact is unassessed.
cases.reason_zh: 报告描述淘汰完成回调被丢弃后，控制器等待与内存检查标志永久保留；按可用性线索暂缓。未执行附带 PoC、TiKV 引擎、控制器或补丁测试，安全影响未评估。

cases.title: Incorrect arguments to mysqld_stmt_execute (MySQL 8.0.22)
cases.reason: The report already includes the SQL, bound parameters, wrapper/PromiseConnection caller frames and a MySQL 8.0.21 versus 8.0.22 comparison. It establishes a prepared-statement execution problem without a demonstrated missing caller or task identity. No local MySQL workload or repair was tested.
cases.reason_zh: 报告已包含 SQL、绑定参数、包装器与 PromiseConnection 调用帧，以及 MySQL 8.0.21/8.0.22 对照；未证明有需 coroPerf 补出的调用者或任务身份。未执行本地 MySQL 负载或修复。

cases.title: Add disconnection detection to pool
cases.reason: A feature request to put disconnection monitoring inside the connection pool, including design constraints and an existing selector recipe. It does not establish a missing asynchronous caller or resource attribution. No pool program or disconnection test was executed.
cases.reason_zh: 请求将断连监测放入连接池，正文讨论设计约束和已有 selector 配方；未建立异步调用者或资源归属缺失问题。未执行连接池程序或断连测试。

cases.title: Using CPU Image without ONNX
cases.reason: A request for a CPU image or build option that can use a backend other than ONNX. The shown async download function does not establish missing caller or task attribution. No TEI image, model or download program was executed.
cases.reason_zh: 请求 CPU 镜像或构建选项支持 ONNX 之外的后端；给出的异步下载函数未建立调用者或任务归属缺失问题。未执行 TEI 镜像、模型或下载程序。
